reviewNotes:
Added automatically from The Villager (Farmingdale) - live music calendar. Check the name and add a website or social page.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Cmonty is a solo act (Christian Montanez), sometimes billed as 'CMONTY Trio' (and 'COMNTY TRIO', a typo, on the Villager calendar). His party band 'Calm Coast Collective' also plays The Villager; if it is in the directory it could be cross-linked. Booking is by web form only; no public email/phone. The logo PNG has a faint baked-in checkerboard background (no real transparency); may need cleanup. Skipped a wedding photo on his site that shows a private couple.
description: Stage name of Long Island singer and guitarist Christian Montanez. He uses a loop pedal to layer guitar, vocals, beatboxing and percussion live, covering pop, R&B, rock and soul hits from many decades; he also plays as a trio and with his party band.

evidence.note: Christian Montanez (CMONTY) describes himself as a Long Island-based guitarist and singer who plays from Montauk to Long Beach and NYC, known for live looping.
Official site (logo reads CMONTY) links Instagram and Facebook 'cmontymusic' and YouTube 'cmontyy'; has a booking form on the contact page.
The Villager (Farmingdale) lists 'Live Music: CMONTY' on Thu Oct 8, 2026, 6-9 PM; it also lists a 'CMONTY Trio' night on Oct 2.
His media page says he also leads a customizable party band, Calm Coast Collective, made up of Long Island musicians.
